subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Should bounded platform opener lifecycle live once in shared `open-path.ts` for both gateway callers, or remain configuration-specific while session workspace reveal keeps its existing shared contract?
rationale: The two active PRs intentionally place the same lifecycle behavior on different sides of the gateway boundary, and code evidence does not establish which permanent contract maintainers want.

options.title: Adopt shared ownership
options.body: Use this PR’s shared opener boundary for both gateway callers and retire the configuration-only implementation path.

options.title: Keep configuration-local ownership
options.body: Use the configuration-specific approach and narrow this PR to any independently necessary session-reveal repair.

options.title: Request a unified replacement
options.body: Pause both PRs and request one maintainer-sponsored implementation of the selected boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared ownership
recommendation.body: Use this PR’s shared opener boundary for both gateway callers and retire the configuration-only implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and is the only concrete decision-routing signal in the supplied context.
